title: Yellow Yeasty Algerian Grape Leaves Stir Fry
description: A Jain-friendly, solo-dinner Algerian dish featuring grape leaves and a stir-fry, served on a talavera plate, with a yeasty and crunchy texture.
instructions: Start by rinsing the grape leaves and cutting off the stems.
In a large bowl, mix together the yeast, olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the grape leaves to the bowl and mix well to coat with the yeast mixture.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the grape leaves, cooking for 5 minutes on each side.
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon juice and water, and pour the mixture over the grape leaves.
Continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the grape leaves are tender and slightly caramelized.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let the grape leaves cool for a few minutes.
Serve the grape leaves hot on a talavera plate, garnished with additional lemon juice if desired.
